oracle.engine: dss_capi 0.15.0b4 (OpenDSS SVN r4103); regenerated for WP-U1.6 D12 (SwtControl Normal/State field mapping). WP-U2.4 D6: `swtcontrol_action_open` removed and `swtcontrol_makelike` re-based on `state=open` — EPRI r4133 makes the deprecated `Action` force the ACTUAL state (State=open), which capi015 (this golden's oracle) does NOT (State=closed), so it is no longer default-oracle-pinnable; the D6 behavior is pinned by the swt_control unit tests + the r4133 live decks (swtcontrol_time/midi). `state=open` forces the switch identically on capi015/0.14.5 and r4133, so makelike's State=open is oracle-derived (== swtcontrol_state_open). Values render lowercase (0.14.5/Rust enum), matching the port's `?` surface. The `swtcontrol_locked_then_action` scenario was dropped: capi015 raises the strict PermissiveProperties read-only error (#2024106) on a locked `Action=` write, which the port deliberately does NOT adopt (ledger L2 / C2 dss-ext-only surface) — it silently ignores, unit-pinned by `locked_ignores_action_write` / `locked_ignores_normal_and_state_writes`.
